## Your question

You will write your own question about the data, create a data visualization that can help answer your question, and write an answer to your question. The question/visualization should explore the relationship between at least 2 of the variables in the dataset. Be sure you include both the question and the answer to your question based on the visualization you have created.  It should be a different question than last mini-project.
